description: Type BeyondCorp app connector/connection/gateway creates' HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED ('This function is not implemented'). The legacy app-connector surface is not available to projects without a BeyondCorp Enterprise / Chrome Enterprise Premium entitlement; the 501 fell outside HTTP_STATUS_MAP and surfaced as UnknownGCPError, which the default policy retried as a server error. No smithy.api#httpError is set, so the 501 carries no ServerError category and the default policy does not retry it. Observed live 2026-09-28 with validateOnly creates in us-central1.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: BeyondCorp app connectors, connections, and gateways are not available to this project (HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED: 'This function is not implemented'). Not retryable.
